relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.evidence: From the age of 14 studied arts, then theology at Edinburgh

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.object: Edinburgh Association of Theological Students in aid of the Diffusion of the Gospel
relations.evidence: in 1825 founded the Edinburgh Association of Theological Students in aid of the Diffusion of the Gospel.

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.object: Free Church of Scotland’s Indian Mission
relations.evidence: From 1843/47 Superintendent of the Free Church of Scotland’s Indian Mission.

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.evidence: In 1830 he founded the Oriental Christian Spectator

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.evidence: In 1832 he founded a college for both sexes (Ambrolie English School, later known as Scottish Missionary School, General Assembly’s Institution, and finally Wilson College)

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.evidence: In 1835-42 he was President of Bombay Literary Society (soon the Bombay Branch of R.A.S.), then its Life President.

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.role: Fellow and Dean of the Faculty of Arts
relations.evidence: From 1857 Fellow and Dean of the Faculty of Arts in the new University of Bombay

relations.subject: WILSON, John
relations.evidence: served in 1848-61 as President of Cave Temple Commission.
